name: visual-required
method: Searched for visual required-marker patterns (asterisk text, span class containing 'required', visible '*' tokens) adjacent to <input>/<textarea>/<select> emissions. Cross-checked whether the same input has the HTML5 `required` attribute or `aria-required="true"`.
notes: No <span class="required"> markers and no visible asterisk-style required indicators were found in src/, templates/, or assets/js/ across the upload modal, edit modal, profile edit form, or settings forms. The plugin uses inline placeholder text + descriptive labels instead of asterisk markers. The Edit modal (1.2.0) does not visually mark any field as required — title is technically optional in MediaController::update_item, so this is consistent. The Profile-edit form's display_name field is enforced server-side via WP_Error 'rest_invalid_param' rather than visually marked. Nothing to flag.
